name: songstress-extensions
description: Songstress's official extensions (its ports and its themes), one folder each, each released on its own (<id>@<version>), and the signed index every Songstress server reads, published on the index branch.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm --dir sdk typecheck && pnpm --dir theme typecheck
scripts.test: vitest run && pnpm --dir sdk test && pnpm --dir theme test
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm check
